props.description: primary: the one main action on a screen. secondary and outline: alternatives. danger: irreversible actions only.

components.purpose: Buttons start an action: send money, confirm a transfer, freeze a card. The label always says what happens next.
whenToUse: To start an action on the current screen, such as Send, Save or Confirm.
To submit a form (`type="submit"`).
For the single most important action of a screen or section, with `variant="primary"`.
whenNotToUse: To go to another page: use Link.
For icon-only actions: use IconButton, and never for moving money.
For on and off settings: use Switch.
contentGuidelines: Start with a verb and say the outcome: "Send ₺250", "Freeze card", "Download PDF".
Use sentence case, two or three words.
Put the amount in the label of money actions when it helps people check it.
sizes: `xs`: 32 px (compact 28): Dense tables and toolbars on desktop.
`sm`: 36 px (compact 32): Inside cards and list rows.
`md`: 44 px (compact 40): Default for forms and dialogs.
`lg`: 48 px (compact 44): Main actions on mobile screens.
`xl`: 56 px (compact 48): The last step of a mobile flow, usually `fullWidth`.
do: Use one primary button per screen or section.
Keep the primary action on the right in dialogs and at the bottom on mobile.
Use `loading` while an action runs.
dont: Do not use `danger` for normal payments: sending money is not an error.
Do not put two primary buttons next to each other.
Do not disable a submit button to hide errors: let people submit and show what to fix.
Do not use a button for navigation.
Do not mix rounded and pill buttons in one group, or put a pill button inside a form row next to rounded fields.
accessibility: Native `<button>` with `type="button"` by default.
Loading uses `aria-busy` and `aria-disabled`, keeps focus and keeps the accessible name.
Focus uses the `elevation.focus` ring: 3:1 against every surface.
Text on every variant passes WCAG 2.2 AA in every brand and mode.
keyboard: Tab: Moves focus to the control

whenNotToUse: Transactions: use TransactionRow.

sizes: Row: at least 44 px: Grows with content.
do: Use `href` for navigation and `onClick` for actions.
Add `chevron` when the row opens another screen.
dont: Do not put a button inside an interactive row.

Interactive rows use a real link or button with an inset focus ring.

components.name: NavigationBar

props.name: items
props.description: Three to five top-level destinations.

props.name: current
props.description: The label of the current destination.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation, for example "Main".

components.purpose: Bottom navigation for phones: three to five top-level destinations, each with an icon and a label.
whenToUse: The main sections of a mobile app: Home, Payments, Cards, Profile.
whenNotToUse: Desktop: use a side or top navigation.
Actions such as "Send money": navigation goes to places, it does not do things.

dont: Do not use more than five destinations or hide labels.

components.name: NumberInput

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after the number, for example "months". Shown and read with the value.

whenNotToUse: Money: use AmountInput. Long numbers such as IBANs or card numbers: use TextField.

do: Set `min` and `max` and say the range in the hint.
dont: Do not use it for numbers people never change step by step.

The minus and plus buttons are for pointers; keyboard users use the arrow keys, so the buttons are left out of the Tab order.
keyboard: Arrow up and down: Step by `step`
Page up and down: Step by ten steps
Home and End: Jump to `min` and `max`

components.name: PageHeader

props.name: title

whenNotToUse: Inside cards or sections: use Heading.

do: Use IconButtons with labels for actions, such as "Help".

The back button is named "Back" or "Geri".

components.name: Pagination

props.name: page
props.description: The current page, starting at 1.

components.purpose: Moves through a long list, such as a statement, a page at a time.

whenNotToUse: Phones and feeds: load more as people scroll, or show a "Show more" button.
do: Keep the list's sort and filters when the page changes.
Move focus to the top of the list after a page change.
dont: Do not show more than 7 page buttons.

Buttons are named "Page 3", "Previous page" and "Next page".
A polite live region says "Page 3 of 10" after a change.
keyboard: Enter or Space: Goes to the page

components.name: Popover

props.name: trigger
props.description: A single focusable element, usually a Button, IconButton or Link.

props.name: title
props.description: Short heading. Also the popover's accessible name.

components.purpose: Extra detail next to the thing it explains, such as how a fee is calculated. Unlike Tooltip, it can hold links and buttons.
whenToUse: An explanation people open on purpose, with a title and a few sentences or a link.
whenNotToUse: A short hint on hover: use Tooltip.
A task or a form: use Dialog or Sheet.
contentGuidelines: The title is a short question or noun: "How is this fee calculated?"
Keep it under about 40 words.
do: Use a clear trigger, such as an IconButton labelled "About this fee".
dont: Do not hide information people need to decide, such as the fee amount itself.
accessibility: A dialog named by its title; focus moves into it when it opens and back to the trigger when it closes.

components.name: ProgressBar

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, for example "Monthly spending limit".

props.name: valueText
props.description: Text shown on the end side, for example "₺7.500 of ₺10.000". Defaults to a percentage.

props.name: tone
props.description: Pair warning and danger with words in valueText, for example "90% used". Color is never the only signal.

props.name: size
props.description: sm 4 px, md 8 px (default).

components.purpose: Progress toward a goal or limit, such as a savings goal or a daily card limit.
whenToUse: Goals, limits, profile completion.
whenNotToUse: Loading: use Skeleton or Spinner.
contentGuidelines: Always set `valueText` in words for money: "₺4.500 of ₺10.000".
Pair warning and danger with words: "92% used, ₺800 left".
sizes: `sm`: 4 px: Inside rows and cards.
`md`: 8 px: Default.
do: Show the numbers, not only the bar.
dont: Do not rely on the bar color.
accessibility: `progressbar` role named by the label, with `aria-valuetext`.

components.name: RadioGroup

props.name: label
props.description: Group label, read as the question.

components.purpose: Pick exactly one option from 2 to 5 visible choices, with optional descriptions.
whenToUse: When should it arrive? Which statement format?
whenNotToUse: More than about 5 options: use Select.
Instant view switches: use SegmentedControl.
contentGuidelines: Write `label` as the question.
Use `description` to explain the consequence of each option.
do: Set a sensible default when there is one.
dont: Do not use for on and off: use Switch.
accessibility: `radiogroup` named by the label.
Descriptions linked with `aria-describedby`.

components.name: SearchField

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Called on Enter. Results that update while typing do not need it.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Other native props are passed to the root element.

components.purpose: A text field for searching, with a search icon and a clear button. Pill by default.
whenToUse: Searching transactions, recipients, help articles.
whenNotToUse: Choosing one value from a list: use Combobox.
contentGuidelines: The label says what is searched: "Search transactions". The placeholder gives an example: "Merchant or amount".
do: Show the number of results near the list.
dont: Do not use the placeholder as the only label.
accessibility: Wrapped in a `search` landmark.
The clear button is named "Clear search" and moves focus back to the field.

components.name: SegmentedControl

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group, for example "Period".

props.name: size
props.description: sm 36, md 44 (default), lg 48 px: the same heights as Button and TextField.

props.name: shape
props.description: rounded: the size's control radius. pill: fully rounded track and items, to sit next to pill buttons.

components.purpose: Switch between 2 to 5 views or filters of the same content, such as Week, Month and Year.
whenToUse: Changing the period of a chart, list or chart view, Now or Later.
whenNotToUse: Navigation between pages: use Tabs.
Form choices with descriptions: use RadioGroup.
contentGuidelines: One word per option when possible.
sizes: `sm`: 36 px (compact 32): Above charts and inside cards.
`md`: 44 px (compact 40): Default.
`lg`: 48 px (compact 44): Main switch of a mobile screen.
do: Keep options mutually exclusive.
dont: Do not use more than 5 options.
accessibility: `radiogroup` named by `label`.
The selected option uses a raised surface and shadow, not color alone.

components.name: Select

props.name: size
props.description: sm 36 px, md 44 px (default), lg 48 px.

props.name: shape
props.description: rounded: the size's control radius. pill: fully rounded ends, to sit next to pill buttons, for example in a search bar.

components.purpose: Pick one option from a list in a popover. Built on Radix Select.
whenToUse: 5 to 15 options, such as the account to pay from.
whenNotToUse: 2 to 5 options that people should compare: use RadioGroup.
Long lists: use a searchable list.
contentGuidelines: Write the placeholder as a request: "Choose an account".

sizes: `sm`: 36 px (compact 32): Dense desktop forms. Keeps a 44 px hit area.
`md`: 44 px (compact 40): Default. Same height as a md Button and TextField.
`lg`: 48 px (compact 44): Main choice of a screen.
do: Order options by how often they are used.
dont: Do not hide important differences between options: use RadioGroup with descriptions.
Do not use Select for actions: use DropdownMenu.
accessibility: The trigger is a labelled combobox.
Options are at least 44 px tall.
keyboard: Enter, Space or Arrow down: Opens the list

components.name: Sheet

props.name: side
props.description: bottom on phones by default; end slides in from the inline end (right in left-to-right), start from the inline start, for navigation.

components.purpose: A panel for a task in context, such as filters or transaction details.
whenToUse: Filters, details and short forms that keep the page behind in view.
whenNotToUse: Confirmations: use Dialog.
contentGuidelines: Title names the task: "Filter transactions".
do: Put the main action last in `footer`.
dont: Do not open a sheet from a sheet.

Modal dialog: traps focus, closes on Escape and returns focus.
Respects the safe area at the bottom of phones.

components.name: Skeleton

props.name: width
props.description: Any CSS length. Defaults to 100% for text and rect.

props.name: height
props.description: Any CSS length. Text skeletons follow the line height.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of text lines. The last one is shorter.

components.purpose: A placeholder in the shape of content that is loading.

whenNotToUse: Waits longer than a few seconds without a message.
Actions: use Button loading.
contentGuidelines: Match the shape of the content that will appear.
do: Mark the loading region with `role="status"`, `aria-busy` and a label.
dont: Do not show skeletons for content that loads instantly.
accessibility: Hidden from screen readers: the region announces loading.

components.name: SkipLink

props.name: targetId
props.description: The id of the main content, without "#".

props.name: label
props.description: Defaults to "Skip to main content" in the locale.

components.purpose: A link that lets keyboard and screen reader users jump past the navigation to the main content. Hidden until it gets focus.

whenNotToUse: Inside components or dialogs.
do: Put it before the logo and navigation.
dont: Do not hide it with `display: none`: it must be focusable.
accessibility: A normal link, so screen readers list it with the page's links.
Text defaults to "Skip to main content" or "Ana içeriğe geç".

components.name: Slider

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Called when people let go, for expensive updates.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: How the value is shown and read, for example (v) => formatAmount(v, { currency: "TRY", locale }).

props.name: showLimits
props.description: Labels under the two ends, for example the minimum and maximum amounts.

components.purpose: Picks a value in a range when the feel matters more than the exact number, such as a monthly saving amount.

whenNotToUse: Exact values people already know: use AmountInput or NumberInput.
contentGuidelines: Format the value for people with `formatValue`, for example with `formatAmount()`.
do: Pair it with a field when an exact value is also useful.
dont: Do not use a slider for more than a few hundred steps.

The track has a 44 px tall hit area.
keyboard: Page up and down: Larger steps
Home and End: Jump to the limits

components.name: Spinner

props.name: label
props.description: With a label the spinner is announced as a status. Without one it is decorative.

components.purpose: A small wait indicator when the shape of the result is unknown.
whenToUse: Short waits inside a region.
whenNotToUse: Page content: use Skeleton.
Inside buttons: use Button `loading`.

sizes: `sm`: 16 px: Inline.
`md`: 20 px: Default.
`lg`: 32 px: Empty regions.

dont: Do not show several spinners at once.

With reduced motion it keeps turning slowly so it never looks frozen.

components.name: Stack

props.name: direction
props.description: vertical (default) stacks children top to bottom; horizontal puts them in a row.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Other native props are passed to the root element.

components.purpose: Lays out children in a column or a row with a gap from the spacing scale, so screens never need hand-written margins.

whenNotToUse: A two-dimensional layout with columns: use CSS grid with the grid tokens.
Spacing inside a component: components handle their own spacing.

components.name: Stepper

props.name: steps
props.description: Short step names, for example ["Recipient", "Amount", "Review", "Confirm"].

components.purpose: Shows where people are in a multi-step flow, such as a transfer.

whenNotToUse: Single screens or more than 5 steps.
contentGuidelines: Short step names: Recipient, Amount, Review, Confirm.
do: Let people go back with a Back button.
dont: Do not make steps clickable unless going back is safe.

components.name: Switch

props.name: label
props.description: Describe the setting, not the state: "Card payments online", not "On".

components.purpose: Turns a setting on or off immediately, such as online card payments.
whenToUse: Settings that take effect right away.
whenNotToUse: Choices inside a form with a submit button: use Checkbox.
contentGuidelines: Label the setting, not the state: "Online card payments", not "On".
Use the hint to explain consequences or why it is disabled.
sizes: Track: 44 by 24 px: Full width is the touch target.
do: Confirm risky changes with a toast or dialog.
dont: Do not use "On" and "Off" as labels.

The track meets 3:1 against every surface.

components.name: Table

props.name: caption
props.description: Says what the table lists, for example "Transactions in November". Read as the table's name.

props.name: sort

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown in one row when there are no rows.

components.purpose: Rows and columns of data people compare, such as a statement on desktop.

whenNotToUse: Phones: use List with TransactionRow.
Layout: never use a table to place things on a page.

Amounts align to the end and use AmountDisplay.

dont: Do not put more than one action in a row; use a DropdownMenu.

The scroll frame is focusable and named by the caption, so keyboard users can scroll it.
keyboard: Tab: Moves to the scroll frame and to sort buttons
Arrow keys: Scroll the frame when it has focus
Enter or Space: Sorts by the column

components.name: Tabs

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the tab list, for example "Account views".

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch tabs to fill the width, for mobile segmented views.

components.purpose: Switch between views of the same object, such as Activity, Statements and Details of an account.

whenNotToUse: Steps of a flow: use Stepper.
Filters: use SegmentedControl or Chip.

do: Keep the selected tab when people come back.

components.name: Text

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Other native props are passed to the root element.

components.purpose: Body text, labels, subtitles, captions and inline code, using the type roles and text tones of the system.

whenNotToUse: Headings: use Heading so the page outline is correct.

Use `tabular` for numbers that line up in columns.

components.name: BalanceHeader

The toggle uses `aria-pressed` and changes its label; hidden balances read "Balance hidden".

components.name: OTPInput

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once when every digit is filled.

components.purpose: One-time code entry with paste, SMS autofill and clear errors.
whenToUse: Confirming a transfer or a login with an SMS code.
whenNotToUse: Passwords and PINs that people choose.
contentGuidelines: Say where the code was sent in `hint`: "We sent a code to •••• 4821".
sizes: Box: 48 px: Six boxes by default, `length` changes it.
do: Use `onComplete` to verify automatically.
dont: Do not split the code into separate inputs.
Do not clear the code on error.
accessibility: `autocomplete="one-time-code"` and `inputMode="numeric"`.
The error is linked to the input.

components.name: PaymentCard

props.name: name
props.description: For example "Everyday debit" or "Travel card".

props.name: last4
props.description: The last four digits only. Never pass the full card number.

props.name: expiry
props.description: "MM/YY".

props.name: type
props.description: Network or type shown in the corner, for example "Debit" or "Virtual".

props.name: bank
props.description: Bank name on the card. Defaults to "Leeward".

components.purpose: Card artwork with the masked number, card name, holder and expiry, and a clear frozen state.
whenToUse: Cards screens, card details and card settings.
Confirming which card a setting applies to, for example when freezing a card.
whenNotToUse: Picking a card from a long list: use ListItem rows with the card name and last four digits.
contentGuidelines: Name cards by use: "Everyday debit", "Travel card".
Expiry is "MM/YY".
do: Put card actions (Freeze, Show details) as Buttons next to the card, not on it.
Show the frozen state on the card itself, so people see it where they look.
dont: Do not pass or show the full card number or the CVV on this component.
Do not show frozen with color alone: the badge says it in words.
accessibility: An article named in one sentence: card name, "Card ending in 4 8 2 1", expiry and "Frozen" when it is.
The visual details are hidden from screen readers so they are not read twice.
Text sits on the primary fill using the color made for it, so contrast passes in every brand and mode.

components.name: QuickActions

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group, for example "Quick actions".

components.purpose: A row of shortcuts such as Send, Request, Top up and Pay bills. It wraps on narrow screens.
whenToUse: Home screens, under the balance.
whenNotToUse: More than four shortcuts on phones.
contentGuidelines: One or two words per action.
Use `badge` only for a count that needs attention.
do: Use duotone icons that match the label.
dont: Do not use icon-only shortcuts: every action has a text label.
accessibility: A labelled list of buttons or links.
Each target is at least 44 px.

components.name: RecipientRow

props.name: name
props.description: The person's or company's name, as saved.

props.name: bank
props.description: Bank name, for example "Leeward" or "Ziraat Bankası".

props.name: avatarSrc
props.description: Photo or logo. Initials are shown without it.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Choose this recipient. Renders the row as a button.

props.name: href
props.description: Open the recipient's page. Renders the row as a link.

components.purpose: A saved recipient: avatar, name, bank and masked IBAN. Choosing the row starts a transfer to them.
whenToUse: Recipient pickers in a transfer flow.
Lists of saved recipients and favorites.
whenNotToUse: Past transactions: use TransactionRow.
Your own accounts: use AccountCard.
contentGuidelines: Use the name the person saved, not the legal account holder name, when they differ.
Always show the last four IBAN digits so people can tell two recipients apart.
do: Put favorites first.
Use inside List so rows get dividers and spacing.
dont: Do not show the full IBAN in a list.
Do not make the row and a button inside it do different things.
accessibility: The IBAN is masked visually and read as "IBAN ending in 1 3 2 6".
The favorite star has text for screen readers, not color or shape alone.
The avatar is decorative because the name is next to it.

components.name: SavingsGoal

props.name: name
props.description: For example "Holiday fund".

props.name: icon
props.description: One of the names in `icons` at the top of this manifest.

props.name: onAddMoney
props.description: Shows an "Add money" button.

components.purpose: A savings goal: what people saved, the target, progress and the date they want to reach it.
whenToUse: Savings screens and the home screen, one card per goal.
whenNotToUse: Spending limits: use ProgressBar with a warning tone and words.
Account balances: use AccountCard.
contentGuidelines: Name goals in the person's words: "Holiday fund", "New laptop".
Show the date as a full date: "By 1 June 2027".
do: Offer "Add money" on the goal itself.
Keep amounts in the goal's currency.
dont: Do not color the bar red when people are behind: saving less is not an error.
accessibility: An article named by the goal.
The progress bar has a visible label ("Progress") and value text, so progress is never shown by color alone. The goal name comes from the article.

components.name: SpendingBreakdown

props.name: title
props.description: For example "Spending in November".

components.purpose: Spending by category for a period: the total, one bar that shows the shape, and a list with names, amounts and shares.
whenToUse: Monthly spending insights and budget screens.
whenNotToUse: Trends over time: use a line chart.
A single limit: use ProgressBar.
contentGuidelines: Title names the period: "Spending in November".
Category names are short and familiar: "Groceries", "Transport".
do: Keep the list next to the bar: it is the readable version of the chart.
Limit the list to the main categories and group the rest as "Other".
dont: Do not use red for spending: spending money is not an error.
Do not show the bar without the list.
accessibility: A section named by its title. The bar is hidden from screen readers; the list carries every value.
Each row reads name, share ("32% of total") and amount, so color is never the only signal.
In forced colors mode the bar and swatches get outlines.

components.name: SummaryList

props.name: total
props.description: Emphasized last row with a line above it, for example the total that leaves the account.

components.purpose: Label and value pairs that let people check a transfer before they send it, or read a receipt after.
whenToUse: The review step of a transfer or payment: recipient, amount, fee, arrival time, total.
Receipts and transaction details.
whenNotToUse: Lists people choose from: use List and ListItem.
Long forms: show the fields, not a summary.
contentGuidelines: Labels are short nouns: "Recipient", "Fee", "Arrives".
Show the fee even when it is zero: "₺0,00", with a hint that says why.
The total is the exact amount that leaves the account.
do: Put the total last and make it the amount people approve.
Use AmountDisplay for amounts so signs and formatting stay consistent.
dont: Do not hide fees or exchange rates in a hint or tooltip.
Do not use the summary for editable values: link back to the step instead.
accessibility: A description list (`dl`, `dt`, `dd`), so screen readers announce each label with its value.
The total row is a normal row with stronger styling, read in order.

components.name: TransactionRow

props.name: amount
props.description: Positive number. Direction decides the sign.

props.name: icon
props.description: One of the names in `icons` at the top of this manifest.

components.purpose: One transaction: merchant, category, date, amount and status. The row reads as one sentence for screen readers.
whenToUse: Activity lists, statements.
whenNotToUse: Other kinds of rows: use ListItem.
contentGuidelines: Merchant names as shown on receipts; categories in plain words.
do: Use inside List or any `ul`.
Pass `onClick` to open details.
dont: Do not color the row by direction.
accessibility: One sentence: merchant, category, date, direction, amount, status.
The sentence starts with the visible merchant name, so voice control works.
